cards.name: Adrenaline Shot
cards.text: The next time you Sprint you do not need to roll the Sprint die and may Move 4 spaces

cards.name: Blueprints
cards.text: Select a Point of Interest. The Adversary must reveal any {point-of-interest} (Point of Interest) tokens that are within 2 spaces of it

cards.name: Cross
cards.text: The Adversary may not use any of their Ability cards during their next turn. They may still use Attacks and Core Actions on their player board

cards.name: Dirty Rag
cards.text:
Place the {dirty-rag} (Dirty Rag) token on the main board on an adjacent Map Hazard
This Map Hazard no longer affects the Investigators or the Adversary for the remainder of the game

cards.name: Emergency Flare
cards.text:
Place a Flashlight on an adjacent space. Cards and Abilities that modify Flashlights still impact this Item
This never costs any {charge} and does not count as a Final Action, and you may still use your regular Flashlight if there is a template left

cards.name: Energy Bar
cards.text: Gain 2 {lungs}

cards.name: Energy Drink
cards.text: You may take the Move Action twice this turn

cards.name: Firecrackers
cards.text:
Select a space within 3 spaces of your current position. All Adversary figures must immediately Move 2 spaces towards that space
The Adversary may still Move normally on their turn

cards.name: Fresh Batteries
cards.text: Gain 2 {charge}

cards.name: Glowstick
cards.text:
Place the {glowstick} (Glowstick) token on the main board within 4 spaces. That space and all spaces within 2 of it are now Dim
You may only use this Item once per round. Remove the token at the end of the round

cards.name: Journal
cards.text: You may use this Item when turning in a piece of Evidence to gain an additional reward, as if you had turned in one extra piece of Evidence

cards.name: Kerosene
cards.text:
Place 2 {flame} (Flame) tokens on the main board adjacent to yourself and each other. The Adversary may not Move onto these tokens, and any Investigators that Move onto these tokens gain a {face-up-wound}
Remove the tokens at the end of the round

cards.name: Lantern
cards.text:
Place the {lantern} (Lantern) token on the main board on an adjacent space. That space and all adjacent spaces are now Bright
Remove the token at the end of the round

cards.name: Leather Jacket
cards.text: If you gain 1 or more {face-up-wound}, you may use this Item to take {face-down-wound} instead

cards.name: Lucky Dice
cards.text: You may re-roll any of your dice rolls and choose which roll to keep

cards.name: Makeshift IV
cards.text: If an adjacent Investigator agrees, you may transfer 1 {blood} from yourself to that Investigator or from that Investigator to you

cards.name: Motion Detector
cards.text: The Adversary must show the Investigators what they roll on the Sprint die on their next turn

cards.name: Painkillers
cards.text:
You must have at least 1 {face-up-wound} card in order to use this Item
Draw 2 new {face-up-wound} cards. You may replace 1 of your existing {face-up-wound} cards with 1 of the 2 new cards if you choose

cards.name: Rabbit's Foot
cards.text:
If you take the final {blood} that would kill you, roll a D6
On a 5+, you still take the {blood} but do not die
You must roll again at the end of each of your turns, and you die immediately if you roll less than a 5 or if the Adversary Attacks you again

cards.name: Security Bar
cards.text:
Place the {security-bar} (Security Bar) token on the main board on top of an adjacent {locked-door} (Locked Door) or {damaged-door} (Damaged Door) token
The next time the Adversary takes the Break Door Action on this Door, remove the {security-bar} token rather than flipping or replacing the Door token

cards.name: Sedatives
cards.text: Skip your next turn, then remove all {obstruction} (Obstruction) tokens from your Stamina track and set your {lungs} to its maximum

cards.name: Survival Kit
cards.text: You may ignore the effects of an Event card for this turn

cards.name: Torch
cards.text:
Place the {torch} (Torch) token on the main board on the Zone you are in. This Zone is now Dim for the rest of the round
Remove the token at the end of the round
You may not use this Item if you are not in a Zone

cards.name: Tourniquet
cards.text: You may ignore a {face-up-wound} this round, delaying its effects until next round

cards.name: Two-way Radio
cards.text:
You may use the Minor Ability of an Investigator that is not in play
If the Ability uses tokens, you may use 1 of them but cannot keep the rest

cards.name: Whiskey
cards.text:
Roll a D6:
1-2: Decrease your {footprint} by 1 on your next turn
3-4: Gain 1 {lungs} or {charge}
5-6: Immediately gain 1 {lungs}, and increase your {footprint} by 1 on your next turn

cards.name: Crystal Amulet
cards.text:
You may look at up to the top 3 cards of the Event deck and rearrange them in any order
You cannot move the Major Event card from the bottom of the deck

cards.name: Spare Tools
cards.text:
Use this Item to make an {involved-action} (Involved Action) count as an Interact Action instead. This does not end your turn, but you may not take another {involved-action} this turn
You may still take a different Final Action and gain {lungs} if you Rest

cards.name: Stray Mutt
cards.text: You may pick up a Revealed {point-of-interest} (Point of Interest) or {medical-item} (Medical Item) token within 3 spaces of you as if you were on that space

cards.name: Tripod
cards.text:
You may take the Place Flashlight Final Action at any point during your turn (without ending your turn). You may not take another Final Action this turn
Your Flashlight remains on the board for the rest of the round, even if you Move after placing it. If you choose to Rest, you gain {lungs} at the end of your turn

cards.name: Whistle
cards.text: You may move up to 2 Investigators 2 spaces closer to yourself, treating Dark spaces as Dim. Map Hazards retain their effects

cards.name: Ghillie Suit
cards.text:
At the start of your turn, remove your Investigator from the board, placing the {ghillie-suit} (Ghillie Suit) token in its place
You cannot take any other Actions this turn, but also cannot be affected by Attacks, Abilities, or Events. Return to the board at the end of the round

cards.name: Metal Detector
cards.text: The Adversary must Reveal any Hidden tokens within 2 spaces of you each time you use this Item

cards.name: Spare Batteries
cards.text: You may spend a {supply} token from this card instead of spending a {charge} when using a Flashlight

cards.name: Adrenaline Shot
cards.text: The next time you Sprint, roll a D6 twice instead of rolling the Sprint die. Use the higher of the two rolls as your Sprint movement
cards.notes: Alternate version of Adrenaline Shot with different rules text; card bears a circled 'MI' set mark (bottom-right), likely an expansion/variant set

cards.name: Cross
cards.text: The Adversary must place a {noise} (Noise) token on the main board on any Door spaces they Move onto this round
cards.notes: Alternate version of Cross with different rules text; card bears a circled 'MI' set mark (bottom-right)

cards.name: Dirty Rag
cards.text: You may ignore the effects of 1 Map Hazard
cards.notes: Alternate version of Dirty Rag with different rules text; card bears a circled 'MI' set mark (bottom-right)

cards.name: Lantern
cards.text:
Place the {lantern} (Lantern) token on the main board on an adjacent space. That space is Bright, and everything within 3 spaces of it is Dim
You may only use this Item once per round. Remove the token at the end of the round
cards.notes: Alternate version of Lantern with different rules text; card bears a circled 'MI' set mark (bottom-right)

cards.name: Rabbit's Foot
cards.text:
You may look at the next 2 Event cards and replace 1 of them with any discarded Event card, then place the cards back on top of the Event deck in the same order
You may not replace the Major Event card
cards.notes: Alternate version of Rabbit's Foot with different rules text; card bears a circled 'MI' set mark (bottom-right)

cards.name: Flashbang
cards.text: If any Adversary figures are within 2 spaces of you when you use this Item, those figures may not take an Action against you on their next turn
cards.notes: Card bears a circled 'NF' set mark (bottom-right), likely an expansion/variant set

cards.name: Lens Filter
cards.text: You may select a different Flashlight Augment to use this round, including one that another Investigator is using
cards.notes: Card bears a circled 'NF' set mark (bottom-right)

cards.name: Reflector
cards.text: Place the {reflector} (Reflector) token on the main board within 3 spaces of a space in your Flashlight's line of sight. This space also counts as if it has line of sight and has the same effect as your current Flashlight
cards.notes: Card bears a circled 'NF' set mark (bottom-right)

cards.name: Spotlight
cards.text:
Use the straightedge as your Flashlight. Any space that is touched is considered Bright (even if it is not fully covered) as long as there are no Obstacles between the space and your Investigator
This still costs 1 {charge}
cards.notes: Card bears a circled 'NF' set mark (bottom-right)

_v1Scope: v1 includes base + MI cards; NF cards excluded per designer decision (2026-07-26).
